topic: Municipal bond interest is federal-tax-free, so a 3.5% muni can beat a 4.5% taxable bond after tax
title: How a 3.5% Bond Can Beat a 4.5% Bond
description:
Most investors miss this. A bond with a lower interest rate can actually pay you more than one with a higher rate. It all comes down to one word: taxes.
